variants.headline: Looking back: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The leader of {party} was being challenged.

A party ought to be capable of discussing its direction without treating every question as disloyalty. Our principles also require a contest to be about more than personal advancement. The purpose of challenging leadership should be intelligible in terms of the convictions an organisation exists to serve.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The position of {target} deserves scrutiny without assuming that a challenge is either justified or doomed. The existence of a contest is the known fact on which this account rests.

variants.headline: Looking back: leadership becomes a contested question
variants.sub: Leadership of the party {party} is under challenge.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: A challenge to the leadership of {party} had opened.

A party ought to be capable of discussing its direction without treating every question as disloyalty. Our principles also require a contest to be about more than personal advancement. The purpose of challenging leadership should be intelligible in terms of the convictions an organisation exists to serve.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The position of {target} deserves scrutiny without assuming that a challenge is either justified or doomed. The existence of a contest is the known fact on which this account rests.
